steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: The Roman legion was the basic military unit of about 5,000 men, divided into 10 cohorts of 6 centuries of 80 men each | Key Fact: Legionaries carried a pilum (javelin) and gladius (short sword); the pilum's soft iron shank bent on impact, making shields unusable | Key Fact: Roman engineering: roads (over 400,000 km of roads connecting the empire), aqueducts (gravity-fed water supply), and fortifications like Hadrian's Wall | Key Fact: Hadrian's Wall (122 AD) was a 117 km defensive wall across northern Britain, marking the northwest frontier of the empire

steps.title: Homework & Consolidation
steps.body: Consolidation, retrieval on key terms from the roman army &amp; engineering, and one past-paper question.
